system.description:
Battle Amp

You perform a smooth dance filled with elegant steps, but you can't do it alone. You require a Partner. At the beginning of your turn, you select a Partner: a willing creature you can see, until the beginning of your next turn. You can only have 1 Partner at a time.

When you begin your turn within 10 feet of your willing partner you both gain: Move in Tandem, Battle Step, Cascade Step and Defensive Dance (see the feature).

You can dance for the duration of combat and end it early at no action on your turn. A Bonus Action switches your dance.
system.summary: Dance with a Partner: Move in Tandem, Battle Step, Cascade Step (−2 AC), Defensive Dance (resistance). For the rest of combat.

rules.text: Waltz: at the start of your turn pick a willing Partner you can see. When you begin your turn within 10 feet of them, you both gain: Move in Tandem (1 Discipline: share a turn), Battle Step (move together instead of moving), Cascade Step (1 Discipline: a Dex save vs the Weapon Specialist's Taijutsu DC or −2 AC until your next turn), Defensive Dance (Reaction + 2 Discipline: resistance to the triggering damage).
Give this Amp to your Partner too (drag the card onto them); a Partner without Discipline spends the Weapon Specialist's.
